asr.full_text: There's a lot of great research being done here. I see lots of greenhouses. We have more than 10 greenhouses in the vertical farm here. Do you get to eat lots of the experiments? Yes. Tomatoes. They feed me tomatoes. Lots of tomatoes. Lettuce. Wow. Is there any soil in this system? No. No soil at all? No soil. They are controlling the amount of nitrogen. The filtration system dispenses water containing nitrogen,. Which is where the plants derive their nutrients. So really you're growing a lot of tomatoes. In very limited space. Yes. I've never eaten a tomato like this before. The reason this greenhouse is shaped like a bunker. Is because, well, it is a bunker,. Built to grow food that will withstand natural disasters. We are in the dome of a farm. This is so cool! So they are growing 250,000 plants per year here. Do plants grow differently under different kinds of light? Yes. So each LED has different wavelengths in the mixture. Red and green and blue and far red and maybe UV. The scientists here are doing cutting-edge research. On how specific colors of light will change the growth,. The flavor and even the texture of the vegetables they produce. We have earthquakes quite often. So this kind of dome and this technology is really, really needed in this country. All components of a farm, sun, wind, all of that can be recreated in this small space. Use less space and grow more food. Vertical. Vertical.
